The application directly uses the signed bzh_dell_smm_io_x64.sys driver
from DellFanCmd 1.1. Driver author: 424778940z. Signed by Aaron Kelley.
The driver is unmodified and licensed under GPLv3 (see DellSmm-LICENSE.txt).
Binary source: https://github.com/AaronKelley/DellFanCmd/releases/tag/1.1
Driver source: https://github.com/424778940z/bzh-windrv-dell-smm-io
Vendored source revision: 67786c69a80f2dd3e0d948cfaba6ced6c2c090e3
Unmodified upstream source, including build files and assembly source:
https://github.com/hippogamesunity/DellSmmFanControl/tree/main/dependencies/driver-source
Pinned upstream snapshot:
https://github.com/424778940z/bzh-windrv-dell-smm-io/tree/67786c69a80f2dd3e0d948cfaba6ced6c2c090e3
The source is also included in GitHub's Source code archives for this release.
The driver is not rebuilt here.
SHA-256: c524435027b6c252464dab58e78cb01f7a09c820dad870677aa15b62b974b2af

No PawnIO or SpeedFan dependency. No setup program is run.
Windows registers a demand-start kernel service while the application runs.
On normal exit, the application stops the driver and deletes its own service.
A crash or forced termination can leave the driver loaded until reboot and
its service registration until the next successful launch/cleanup.
Windows event logs can retain records of driver loading.

The application's noncommercial license does not apply to this driver or
its source. They retain their original GPLv3 terms, including commercial rights.
